plan: OpenVibe End-to-End Realignment & Implementation Plan, revision 3 (20 Sep 2026)
deployment: Deployed with `sudo ovhost deploy reviews`: unit openvibe-reviews, 127.0.0.1:4830 behind nginx; Events subscription sources.item.* in place; on 2026-09-23 /api/ready answered 200 and the production database held 0 entities and 0 signals. Public at openvibe.reviews since 2026-10-09 after an independent pre-launch security review whose fixes shipped first; the database stays empty until a person verifies a review source's terms and enables it in Sources, and an editor publishes (REVIEWS_EDITORS holds the owner only)
seed: none: no entities, signals, summaries or ratings are seeded
dataSource: OpenVibe.Sources category reviews; no review source is enabled there yet (all 6 Sources seeds are disabled)
features: signals from OpenVibe.Sources by cursor pull and signed webhook, with provenance
deterministic entity resolution; a name alone never resolves
aggregates only from existing signals, with revisions
exact merge and split round trips, audited
editor trust decisions shown with reasons
summaries written or approved by a person; AI drafts never yield a rating
server-rendered pages and editor workflows useful without JavaScript
SDK outbox events and Search index documents
